install: python3 -m pip install --no-input -r server/requirements.txt && if [ ! -d "${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/android-sdk}/platforms/android-34" ] && command -v sdkmanager >/dev/null 2>&1; then (yes || true) | sdkmanager --licenses >/dev/null && sdkmanager "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"; fi && if [ -x android/gradlew ]; then (cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon); else gradle -p android assembleDebug --no-daemon; fi
